::: {#def-npsem .theorem}
## Non-parametric structural equation model \[NPSEM\]

A [statistical model](#def-statistical-model) defined relative to a [directed acyclic graph](#def-dag) $\mathcal G$ on $\mathbf V$. Each [random variable](#def-random-variable) $V$ is returned by a deterministic function $f_V$, called a structural equation, of its parents $\mathbf{Pa}(V)$ in $\mathcal G$ and an error term $U_V$:

$$
V = f_V\big(\mathbf{Pa}(V), U_V\big), \qquad V \in \mathbf V.
$$

The parameter is the set of structural equations together with $P_{\mathbf U}$, the joint law of the error terms $\mathbf U = (U_V)_{V \in \mathbf V}$:

$$
\theta = \big(\{f_V\}_{V\in\mathbf V},\, P_{\mathbf U}\big).
$$

Written in a [topological order](#def-dag) of $\mathcal G$, each variable is a function of variables that precede it:

$$
V_{j} = f_{V_j}\big(\mathbf{Pa}(V_j),\, U_{V_j}\big), \qquad \mathbf{Pa}(V_j)\subseteq\{V_1,\dots,V_{j-1}\}.
$$
:::
